title: Subcounty Resident Population Estimates, Georgia: April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025 (SUB-EST2025_13)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
geography: Georgia incorporated places, county parts of places and counties
measures: Estimates base 2020 → July 1 2025: Macon-Bibb County 157,358 → 157,556; Sandy Springs 108,110 → 105,013; Alpharetta 65,810 → 66,921; Roswell 92,834 → 91,505; Marietta 61,060 → 63,574; Johns Creek 82,444 → 80,401; Lawrenceville 30,638 → 32,822; Atlanta 498,805 → 529,110; Fulton County 1,066,559 → 1,098,791; Cobb 766,088 → 793,345; Gwinnett 957,385 → 1,018,099; Georgia 10,713,861 → 11,302,748. County-part rows place Sandy Springs, Alpharetta, Johns Creek and Roswell in Fulton (Roswell also has a Cobb part with 0 estimated residents), Marietta in Cobb, Lawrenceville in Gwinnett.
limitations: Model-based estimates revised each vintage; compare only within Vintage 2025. Percent changes on the site are derived from this file.

title: House Resolution 1697 (LC 112 3889): Celebrating the 205th anniversary of the City of Lawrenceville
